purpose: Translate particle, wave, stochastic, coherent, emergent, collapse, entanglement, and memory descriptions of gravity into comparable observable laws without treating conformity to standard theory as a prerequisite for testing.

score_contract.rule: Axes are reported separately. They are not added, averaged, multiplied, or used as a probability of truth.

equivalence_theorem.statement: For y=R h+n, if two mediator models give the same deterministic mean, the same transfer R, zero-mean Gaussian h with the same covariance C_h, and the same independent Gaussian detector noise N, then both induce exactly the same multivariate-normal record y~Normal(R mean(h), R C_h R^T+N). No statistic of that classical record can distinguish their ontology.
equivalence_theorem.proof_object: symbolic covariance push-forward plus exact rational fixture
equivalence_theorem.scope: linear readout and Gaussian field/noise states only
escape_witnesses: nonzero third or connected fourth cumulant

theory_cards.probability_noise: Poisson occupation per coherent mode, Gaussian quadrature vacuum noise, connected cumulants above second vanish for linear quadratures.

theory_cards.ontology: Discrete gravity entities are captured into a persistent reservoir; accumulated occupation biases later matter/clock motion until the reservoir relaxes.
theory_cards.state_space: Local occupation N in nonnegative integers plus matter and photon channels; optional coherent superpositions are not assumed.
theory_cards.dynamics: dN=lambda_capture(t)dt-dJ_release with death rate N/tau; response a_extra=a_q N and clock shift delta nu/nu=b_q N.
theory_cards.probability_noise: Immigration-death process: stationary N is Poisson with mean lambda tau, autocovariance lambda tau exp(-|Delta t|/tau), and equal-time cumulants all lambda tau.

equivalence_relations: At large occupation its mean and two-point response can mimic a Gaussian exponential-memory field; finite-occupation third/fourth cumulants distinguish it.
